∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {m : ι → ℕ} {F ψ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ}
  (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (γ : (j : ι) → BfgsVerification.Vec (m j) → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : ι), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (γ j)) →
    (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (γ j)) →
      (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec (m j)), 0 ≤ γ j x) →
        ∀ (A : (j : ι) → BfgsVerification.Vec n →ₗ[ℝ] BfgsVerification.Vec (m j)) (p : ι → ℝ),
          (∀ (j : ι), 1 ≤ p j) →
            ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
              (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
                ∀ {U : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
                  IsOpen U →
                    BfgsVerification.CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ →
                      IsCompact R.initialSublevel →
                        R.initialSublevel ⊆ U →
                          (∀ x ∈ U, F x = ψ x + ∑ j, γ j ((A j) (x - star)) ^ p j) →
                            Filter.Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) Filter.atTop (nhds (F star)) ∧
                              Filter.Tendsto (fun k => BfgsVerification.euclideanSolutionDistance F (R.x k))
                                  Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                                ((∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F x = F star → x = star) →
                                  Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (nhds star))

  (∀ (j : ι), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (Γ j)) →
    (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (Γ j)) →
      (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), 0 ≤ Γ j x) →
        ∀ (p : ι → ℝ),
          (∀ (j : ι), 1 ≤ p j) →
            ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
              (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
                ∀ {U : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
                  IsOpen U →
                    BfgsVerification.CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ →
                      IsCompact R.initialSublevel →
                        R.initialSublevel ⊆ U →
                          (∀ x ∈ U, F x = ψ x + BfgsVerification.RadialPower.sumObjective Γ p star x) →
                            Filter.Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) Filter.atTop (nhds (F star)) ∧
                              Filter.Tendsto (fun k => BfgsVerification.euclideanSolutionDistance F (R.x k))
                                  Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                                ((∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F x = F star → x = star) →
                                  Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (nhds star))

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ}
  (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T P : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), Matrix.det (P k) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), P (k + 1) = P k * T k) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), V (k + 1) = V k * T k + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k)) →
        ∀ (m K L C : ℝ),
          0 < m →
            0 < K →
              0 ≤ L →
                (∀ (k : ℕ), m ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V k).transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) →
                  (∀ (k : ℕ),
                      BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V (k + 1)).transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) / R.curvature k ≤ C) →
                    (∀ (k : ℕ) (v : Fin r → ℝ),
                        BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((Matrix.transpose (P k)).mulVec v) ≤ K * BfgsVerification.sqNorm v) →
                      (∀ (k : ℕ) (v : Fin r → ℝ),
                          BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((P k)⁻¹.transpose.mulVec v) ≤ L * BfgsVerification.sqNorm v) →
                        ∀ (G : ℝ),
                          0 < G →
                            (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (R.g k) ≤ G ^ 2) →
                              Filter.Tendsto R.d Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → False

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ} (k : ℕ)
  (V W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T : BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  W = V * T + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) b →
    BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian (k + 1)) W =
      Matrix.transpose T *
            (BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian k) V -
              (R.q k)⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer (V.transpose.mulVec (R.g k)) (V.transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) *
          T +
        (R.curvature k)⁻¹ •
          BfgsVerification.outer (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k))

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ}
  (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T P : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), Matrix.det (P k) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), P (k + 1) = P k * T k) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), V (k + 1) = V k * T k + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k)) →
        ∀ (m K L C : ℝ),
          0 < K →
            0 ≤ L →
              (∀ (k : ℕ), m ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V k).transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) →
                (∀ (k : ℕ),
                    BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V (k + 1)).transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) / R.curvature k ≤ C) →
                  (∀ (k : ℕ) (v : Fin r → ℝ),
                      BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((Matrix.transpose (P k)).mulVec v) ≤ K * BfgsVerification.sqNorm v) →
                    (∀ (k : ℕ) (v : Fin r → ℝ),
                        BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((P k)⁻¹.transpose.mulVec v) ≤ L * BfgsVerification.sqNorm v) →
                      ∀ (N : ℕ), m / K * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q k)⁻¹ ≤ R.normalizedFrameEnergy V P 0 + L * C * ↑N

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
  (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T P : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), J ≤ k → Matrix.det (P k) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), J ≤ k → P (k + 1) = P k * T k) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ),
          J ≤ k → V (k + 1) = V k * T k + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k)) →
        ∀ (m K L C : ℝ),
          0 < m →
            0 < K →
              0 ≤ L →
                (∀ (k : ℕ), J ≤ k → m ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V k).transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) →

                      J ≤ k →
                        BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V (k + 1)).transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) / R.curvature k ≤

∀ {n : ℕ} (B C : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),

∀ {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (B : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),

∀ {n : ℕ} (B C : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),

∀ {n : ℕ} (B : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (g y s r : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (q t : ℝ),
  Matrix.IsSymm (B - q⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer g g) →
    Matrix.mulVec (B - q⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer g g) s = 0 →
      BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (B - q⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer g g + t⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer y y) (r + s) =

  Matrix.IsSymm M →
    ∀ {s : BfgsVerification.Vec n},

          BfgsVerification.metricGram M (V + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter s b) =

∀ {n r : ℕ} (B : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (i j : Fin r),
  BfgsVerification.metricGram B V i j = BfgsVerification.dot (fun k => V k i) (Matrix.mulVec B fun k => V k j)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (B : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (g y s : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (q t : ℝ),
  Matrix.IsSymm (B - q⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer g g) →
    Matrix.mulVec (B - q⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer g g) s = 0 →
      ∀ (V W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T : BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : BfgsVerification.Vec r),

∀ {n : ℕ} {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {q δ : ℕ → ℝ} {K C : ℝ},
  BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.NormalizedHierarchy n E q δ K C →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ δ k) →
      ∀ (J m : ℕ),
        0 < m →
          ∀ (η D : ℝ),
            0 < η →
              0 ≤ D →
                ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, δ (J + i) ≤ D →
                  ↑(m + 1) *
                      Real.exp
                        (-(Real.log (C * BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.weightedPotential n (K / η) (E J)) +
                              ↑m * Real.log (η + D / ↑m)) /
                          ↑(m + 1)) ≤
                    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (q (J + i))⁻¹

∀ {n : ℕ} {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {q δ : ℕ → ℝ} {K C : ℝ},
  BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.NormalizedHierarchy n E q δ K C →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ δ k) →
      ∀ (J m : ℕ),
        0 < m →
          ∀ (η D : ℝ),
            0 < η →
              0 ≤ D →
                ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, δ (J + i) ≤ D →
                  ↑(m + 1) *
                        (C * BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.weightedPotential n (K / η) (E J)) ^ (-1 / ↑(m + 1)) *
                      (η + D / ↑m) ^ (-↑m / ↑(m + 1)) ≤
                    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (q (J + i))⁻¹

∀ {n : ℕ} {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {q δ : ℕ → ℝ} {K C : ℝ},
  BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.NormalizedHierarchy n E q δ K C →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ δ k) →
      ∀ (J : ℕ) (D : ℝ),
        0 < D →
          (∀ (m : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, δ (J + i) ≤ D) →
            ∀ a < (2 * D)⁻¹, ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, a ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (q i)⁻¹) / ↑N ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {q δ : ℕ → ℝ} {K C : ℝ},
  BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.NormalizedHierarchy n E q δ K C →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ δ k) →
      ∀ (J m : ℕ),
        0 < m →
          ∀ (D : ℝ),
            0 < D →
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, δ (J + i) ≤ D →
                BfgsVerification.QuantitativeGrowth.normalizedLower
                    (C * BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.weightedPotential n (K / D) (E J)) D n m ≤
                  (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (q (J + i))⁻¹) / (↑m + 1) ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {q δ : ℕ → ℝ} {K C : ℝ},
  BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.NormalizedHierarchy n E q δ K C →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ δ k) →
      Summable δ → Filter.Tendsto (fun N => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (q i)⁻¹) / ↑N ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

∀ (q V a : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (J m : ℕ),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < q k) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < V k) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < a k) →
        0 < C →
          (∀ (k : ℕ), q k * V (k + 1) ≤ a k * V k) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ), q k ≤ C * V k) →
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), Real.log (q (J + i)) ≤
                Real.log (C * V J) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Real.log (a (J + i))

∀ (q : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (L : ℝ),
  0 < m →
    (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < q i) →
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Real.log (q i) ≤ L → ↑m * Real.exp (-L / ↑m) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (q i)⁻¹

∀ (x : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (B : ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < x i) →
    0 < B → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, x i ≤ ↑m * B → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Real.log (x i) ≤ ↑m * Real.log B

∀ (n : ℕ) (r t : ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ),
  0 ≤ r →

        BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.weightedPotential n (r * t) e ≤
          BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.weightedPotential n r e * t ^ n

∀ {n : ℕ} (star z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (G R : ℝ),
  0 ≤ G →
    0 ≤ R →
      BfgsVerification.sqNorm g ≤ G ^ 2 →
        BfgsVerification.sqNorm h ≤ G ^ 2 →
          BfgsVerification.sqNorm (z - star) ≤ R ^ 2 →
            |BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star z g h| ≤ 2 * G * R

∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (star x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.centralDifference F star x t =
    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g
        (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) +
      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x go gm gi : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t C : ℝ),
      0 ≤ t →
        t ≤ 1 / 2 →
          0 ≤ C →
            HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional go)
                (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) →
              HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional gm) x →
                HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional gi)
                    (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) →
                  (0 <
                        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature
                          (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) x go gm →
                      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star x go gm ^ 2 ≤
                        C *
                          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature
                            (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) x go gm) →
                    (0 <
                          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x
                            (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) gm gi →
                        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star
                              (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) gm gi ^
                            2 ≤
                          C *
                            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x
                              (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) gm gi) →
                      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.centralDifference F star x t ≤ 5 * C * t ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},

    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →

          F star < b →
            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star →
              BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasNestedCentralBounds F star b

∀ {n : ℕ} (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},

∀ {n : ℕ} (x y z : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.dot x (y - z) = BfgsVerification.dot x y - BfgsVerification.dot x z

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (b : ℝ),
      F star < b →
        ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
          F x ≤ b →
            ∀ {O D : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
              IsOpen O →
                x ∈ O →
                  Dense D → ∃ u, Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds x) ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ), F (u j) ≤ b ∧ u j ∈ O ∧ u j ∈ D

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (b : ℝ),

∀ {N D T C Tmax : ℝ}, 0 ≤ D → D ≤ T → T ≤ Tmax → N ^ 2 ≤ C * T → (N - D) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * C + 2 * Tmax) * T

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),

∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (star x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) =
    F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) - F x + t * BfgsVerification.dot g (x - star)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
      HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g

          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.centralDifference F star x t

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t C : ℝ),
      0 ≤ t →
        t ≤ 1 / 2 →
          0 ≤ C →
            HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
              HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional h)
                  (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) →
                (0 <
                      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x
                        (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) g h →

                          (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) g h ^
                        2 ≤
